_comment: Shard manifest for the parallel e2e run. The e2e runs on GitHub-HOSTED runners as a 4-shard matrix — each matrix leg is its own isolated VM, so each shard = its own docker stack (own ClickHouse/API/UIs) running a slice of the specs on DEFAULT ports (80/9000/9001) and the DEFAULT docker project (no port juggling, no project prefixes, no /etc/hosts hacks — the *.localhost vhost names resolve to 127.0.0.1 by default on the runner). The 'global-config' shard (node-ads + moderation + discover-board) runs workers=1 so the global node_config mutations (node_ad_percentage / sensitive_words / auto_hide_users) never race. To go faster: bump `runs-on` in .github/workflows/e2e.yml to a larger hosted runner (e.g. a 4-vCPU runner) — each shard gets more CPU for its browser workers.
